subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Enthusiasm
solution:
The correct answer is **"Lethargy"**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let's see the meaning of the word "**Enthusiasm" **and other words mentioned in the options.

 
 
• **Enthusiasm- **intense and eager enjoyment, interest, or approval.
 
• **Lethargy **means a lack of energy and enthusiasm
 
 
• **Example:- **there was an air of lethargy about him
 
 
 
• **Passion **means strong and barely controllable emotion
 
 
• Example:- His dominating passion is his love for children.
 
 
 
• **Eagerness **means enthusiasm to do or to have something; keenness.
 
 
• Example:- The player showed eagerness to play.
 
 
 
• **Energy means **​the strength and vitality required for sustained physical or mental activity.
 
 
• **Example"- ****You **must have good energy to complete your work.
 
 
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct answer is the option no 1 i.e. **Lethargy**
